systems.tiers: 300 administrative census commissions deployed across Mandiana prefecture; launched there on 22 April 2025

note: The launch of the biometric census in Mandiana prefecture on 22 April 2025 with 300 census commissions; these are identity enrolment points for a census, not offices registering births or deaths, so no civil fact.
